classification.difficultyReason: Reverse cost-to-quantity relationships using unitary scaling, with the shares part requiring rounding down because only whole shares can be purchased.

children.label: a
children.prompt: If 10 bananas cost $\$4$, how many can I buy for $\$14$?

answer.worked:
$\$4$ buys 10 bananas.

$\$2$ buys $10\div2=5$ bananas.

$\$14$ buys $7\times5=35$ bananas.

children.label: b
children.prompt: How many shares can I buy for $\$5400$ if 1000 shares cost $\$14$?

answer.short:
385714 whole shares

Use the number of shares bought for $\$7$ and round down to a whole share.
answer.worked:
$\$14$ buys 1000 shares.

$\$7$ buys $1000\div2=500$ shares.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Shares for }\$5400&=\frac{5400}{7}\times500\\\text{Shares for }\$5400&=\frac{2700000}{7}\\\text{Shares for }\$5400&=385714\frac{2}{7}.\end{align*}$$

Therefore, $\$5400$ can buy 385714 whole shares.

children.label: c
children.prompt: At a sale, exercise books cost $\$8$ per dozen. How many can I buy for $\$22$?

answer.worked:
$\$8$ buys 12 exercise books.

$\$2$ buys $12\div4=3$ exercise books.

$\$22$ buys $11\times3=33$ exercise books.

children.label: d
children.prompt: A caterer must buy 4 lettuces to make sandwiches for 50 people. How many lettuces will he need to buy to feed 225 people?

answer.worked:
50 people need 4 lettuces.

25 people need $4\div2=2$ lettuces.

225 people need $9\times2=18$ lettuces.

children.label: e
children.prompt: The first two pages of a student’s essay contain 800 words. How many pages are needed if the essay is to meet the requirement of 5000 words? (Assume that each page contains the same number of words.)

answer.worked:
800 words fill 2 pages.

400 words fill 1 page.

5000 words fill $5000\div400=12.5$ pages.
